question: Who among the following wrote ‘The Light of Asia: The Poem that Defined the Buddha’ that will narrate the phenomenal poem ‘The Light of Asia’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jairam Ramesh.**__

__
 
• **Jairam Ramesh **is the author of the book** The Light of Asia: The Poem that Defined the Buddha.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] Mistake Points__**

__
 
• The Light of Asia is an epic on the life of Lord Buddha by **Edwin Arnold.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Books by Chetan Bhagat - **Five Point Someone, Two States, What Young India Wants**
 
• Books by Shashi Tharoor - **Inglorious Empire, Why I am a Hindu, Pax Indica, Bookless in Baghdad**
 
• Books by** **Salman Rushdie - **Midnight’s Children, The Sellout - Paul Beaty, The Satanic Verses **
